name: kinhop
description: KinHop — motor de decisiones urbanas multicidad, hackatón 2026

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @kindhop/api" "npm run dev -w @kindhop/web"
scripts.check: npm run check -w @kindhop/api && npm run check -w @kindhop/web && npm test && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w @kindhop/api && npm test -w @kindhop/web && node --test scripts/fetch-osm-pois.test.mjs scripts/import-cdmx-gtfs.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kindhop/api && npm run build -w @kindhop/web
